================================================================================
1. EXECUTIVE THESIS: WHAT IS LATENODE AI ARBITRAGE?
================================================================================
AI automation agencies and B2B lead-generation operators routinely lose 45% to
70% of their workflow gross margin to two compounding billing traps:

1. Per-Task / Per-Operation Automation Tax:
   Zapier charges per task and Make charges per module operation (including
   high-frequency polling and data loops). A 10-step lead enrichment workflow
   running across 20,000 leads consumes 200,000+ billable tasks per month.
   Latenode.com meters usage by CPU execution time (30-second credit blocks)
   with native JavaScript/NPM nodes and headless Puppeteer browser automation,
   collapsing multi-step array and scraping workflows into a fraction of the cost.

2. Blanket Frontier LLM Overspending:
   Most agencies send every prompt—JSON cleanup, company deduplication, bounce
   triage, and ICP classification—to flagship frontier models costing $3–$15+
   per million tokens. The Latenode AI Arbitrage Template deploys a deterministic
   complexity router that dispatches ~75% of routine operations to low-cost fast
   models while reserving frontier models strictly for high-leverage copywriting
   and complex analysis.

Combined Result: 45% to 70% average reduction in monthly AI + automation burn,
higher lead throughput, and immediate agency retainer margin expansion.

4. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
================================================================================
Q: How does the Latenode AI Arbitrage Template save 45% to 70% on AI costs?
A: By combining dynamic tiered LLM prompt routing (sending routine parsing and
   qualification to fast low-cost models and reserving frontier models for final
   copy) with Latenode's execution-time credit pricing instead of Zapier/Make
   per-task fees.

Q: Do I need a Latenode.com account first?
A: You can buy the template at https://whop.com/botvibeai immediately and open
   your Latenode workspace via https://latenode.shop (BotVibe AI LLC's partner
   link to Latenode.com). Deployment takes under 20 minutes.

Q: What is the difference between the $299 one-time price and $299/month?
A: $299 one-time gives you permanent ownership of the complete blueprint and
   commercial agency deployment rights. The $299/month maintenance plan is
   completely optional for agencies wanting continuous model price-benchmark
   updates and priority support.

Q: Does cost arbitrage degrade lead quality or personalized outreach?
A: No. High-value personalization and strategic analysis stay on frontier models,
   while mechanical parsing, scraping cleanup, and scoring move to fast models.
